description:
**What:** Verify that cargo test and cargo clippy both pass cleanly for jmap-mime and that the workspace-level gates also pass.

**Algorithm:**
1. Run: cargo test -p jmap-mime
   Assert: 16 tests pass, 1 doc-test passes, 0 failures.
2. Run: cargo clippy -p jmap-mime -- -D warnings
   Assert: zero warnings or errors.
3. Run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
   Assert: no formatting diffs.
4. Run: cargo check --workspace
   Assert: clean.
5. Report exact output of each command.

If any gate fails, report the failure verbatim and do NOT mark the bead done.
Do not fix failures — escalate to a separate bead or to the user.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- This bead runs commands only; it does not modify any file.
- Each command exit code must be explicitly checked.
- A command that failed and was ignored is not a completed step.

**Subagent instructions:**
Single subagent runs all four commands sequentially and reports each output.

**Tests:** N/A — this bead IS the test run.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- cargo test -p jmap-mime: 16 unit tests + 1 doc-test pass, 0 failures.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-mime -- -D warnings: zero warnings.
- cargo fmt --all -- --check: no diff.
- cargo check --workspace: clean.
title: jmap-mime: verify quality gates
